meta.title: Your Credit Card Company Makes Money Even When You Pay It Off In Full
meta.hook: Pay your credit card in full every month and never carry a balance? The card company is still making money off you.
meta.description: Every time you swipe a credit card, the merchant pays a small interchange fee to your card's issuing bank, split with the card network. That fee gets charged whether you pay your statement in full or carry a balance for months. It's a quiet, guaranteed revenue stream built into every transaction, long before any interest ever gets charged.

scenes.narration: Pay your credit card in full every month, never carry a balance? The card company is still making money off you.

visual.query: credit card tap payment terminal close up
visual.visual_intent: A credit card tapping a payment terminal, extreme close up, bright retail light, slow motion
visual.decision_reason: hook beat: the swipe itself, hard cut

scenes.narration: Every swipe triggers a small fee the merchant pays, called an interchange fee.

visual.visual_intent: A cash register printing a receipt at checkout, warm retail light, macro detail
visual.decision_reason: introduces the merchant side of the fee

scenes.narration: That fee is split between your bank and the card network. It gets paid on every purchase, no matter when or how you pay your bill.

visual.query: money flow chart arrows financial diagram
visual.visual_intent: An animated-feeling flow of money moving between three points on a dark chart, teal and gold
visual.decision_reason: visualizes the fee split between issuer and network

scenes.narration: That's why stores accept cards at all, and why some add a surcharge on small purchases.

visual.query: small shop counter sign card minimum
visual.visual_intent: A small shop counter with a handwritten card-minimum sign taped near the register, natural light

scenes.narration: So the rewards, the points, the cash back — a share of that is funded by interchange, collected from every purchase you make.

visual.query: credit card rewards points app phone
visual.visual_intent: A phone screen showing a credit card rewards balance ticking upward, close hand-held framing
visual.decision_reason: connects the fee to the reward the viewer sees

scenes.narration: Paying in full still avoids interest. It just doesn't make the transaction free for everyone else in the chain. Follow for more.
keywords: interest free but not fee free

visual.visual_intent: A wallet with several credit cards fanned out on a wooden table, warm still light
